results.name: Chink in Defenses
results.description: Opponent's AC is halved for attacker's strikes until the next time they are damaged by attacker.

results.name: Followup
results.description: Attacker immediately gains an attack of opportunity on their opponent.

results.name: Tactical Positioning
results.description: Attacker can move themselves and/or their opponent a total of 10 feet. If both are used to steap away from each other, then that is treated as a disengage. This can also be used to get behind their opponent or swap position with them.

results.name: Wide Open
results.description: Opponent has no DEX AC bonus and any attacks on the opponent are at advantage. This lasts until the opponent uses an action.

results.name: Setup
results.description: The next attack by the opponent on any target is at a disadvantage and the attacker gets an opportunity attack on this opponent immediately after that attack.

results.name: Faint
results.description: The next attack by the opponent on the attacker is at disadvantage. If this attack hits, the attacker makes a DEX saving throw (DC 15) to avoid all damage and only takes half damage if they fail the save.

results.name: Savage Advance
results.description: The next strike at the opponent by the attacker is at an advantage and the opponent's next strike at the attacker is at disadvantage.

results.name: Wound
results.description: Opponent takes [[/roll d4]] bleeding damage every subsequent turn of combat after this strike.

results.name: Disarm
results.description: Opponent must make a STR saving throw (DC 15) to keep hold of item held in primary hand.
